history.summary: A new-launch 99-yr leasehold 4BR at The Orie, Toa Payoh (D12), 1,367sqft at $2,484 psf — about 7% below the $2,669 launch median — sitting on a huge 740-transaction base and just 410m from Braddell MRT. The strong arena Elo (1,666, 323-92 record) and below-median pricing make it the best-positioned premium entry here, though the $3.4M price and leasehold tenure cap conviction.
history.rating_rationale: A rare new launch where the listing is ~7% under the project's own median PSF ($2,484 vs $2,669) on an enormous 740-txn base — strong demonstrated demand and a relative-value entry rather than a top-of-market one. Toa Payoh is a highly-sought mature central estate, Braddell MRT is 410m, and the unit is a sensible 1,367sqft 4BR. The offsets — 99-yr leasehold, $3.4M past the deepest liquidity band, and new-launch bias on the rate — keep it a Buy rather than Strong Buy, but the below-median pricing in a heavily-transacted, well-located launch is a genuinely good position.
red_flags: New-launch bias — headline appreciation not yet resale-proven
No built year confirmed in dossier
catalysts: Listed ~7% below the project's own median PSF
410m to Braddell NS-line MRT in mature Toa Payoh
Deep demand — 740 txn and a 323-92 arena record (Elo 1,666)

history.summary: Re-eval under v3.4.1+ priors: the prior Buy (medium) was on a since-removed 1,367sqft 4BR at $2,484 psf (~7% below the ~$2,669 launch median) — that discount WAS the validated edge. The current 4BR (1,216 sqft, $4.10M / $3,372 psf) asks ABOVE the project entire 12-month transacted band ($2,395-3,044 psf, avg ~$2,699) and ~25% above the two other live 4BR asks in the same project ($2,691 / $2,742 psf). Price/sqft pairing is internally consistent and the listing is real, but it is a ~25% premium to own-project median: the one backtested forward signal (cheap-vs-peers) is inverted, project demand strength does not transfer to an above-band ask, and new-launch appreciation narrative carries no resale-proven forward power. Algo score_1000 = 245 (well below the 450 threshold) agrees.
history.rating_rationale: Asks $3,372 psf vs project 12-mo transacted avg ~$2,699 (range $2,395-3,044) — above the entire band; ~25% over sibling 4BR asks ($2,691-2,742 psf); cheap-vs-peers edge inverted; D12 RCR baseline (+3.1%/yr) cannot absorb a ~25% entry premium over a 5-7yr hold; score_1000 245.
red_flags: Ask $3,372 psf exceeds the project entire 12-month transacted range (max ~$3,044)
~25% above the two other live 4BR asks in the same project
99-yr leasehold new launch, TOP ~2028-2030 — no rental income for years of the hold
$4.10M quantum above the deep-liquidity band for D12
Prior Buy rationale (below-median entry) no longer applies — that unit is gone
catalysts: 410m to Braddell MRT (NS18), mature Toa Payoh
Strong project demand base (~680/777 sold, ~740-txn base) — but priced in at this ask
D12 RCR forward baseline +3.1%/yr (accrues to fairly-priced entries, not above-band ones)
